# External documents

`prd-forge-viewer-prd.pdf` is an export of the PRD set, version 0.6.1. The sponsor
approved version 0.6.0 on 2026-10-28. Version 0.6.1 moves the release 1 date and waits for approval. It holds all 18 documents.

The source is `docs/prd/prd-forge-viewer/`. If the PRD changes, export it again
and copy the new PDF to this folder.
